testimonial.title: What Customers Say
testimonial.quote: I rarely write reviews, but this experience truly deserves one. I ordered a bouquet for my mother's birthday and wanted everything to be perfect. From the moment I placed the order, I was continuously updated on its delivery status, which gave me great peace of mind. When the flowers arrived, they were even more beautiful than I imagined — fresh, vibrant, and arranged with great elegance. My mother was deeply moved when she received them. Thank you for turning a simple gift into an unforgettable moment for my family.

shopFresh.title: Shop Fresh Flowers
shopFresh.description: Discover our carefully curated collection of fresh flowers, elegantly arranged by professional florists to bring beauty, fragrance, and timeless grace right to your door.

hero.title: Our Story
hero.intro: The story of Hoa Theo Mua is the story of
hero.introAfter: — about the emotions of flowers, of memories, and of empathy from the soul of a woman who wished to bring peaceful values and nurture positivity through every heartfelt tale.
hero.subtitle: Hanoi — 12 Flower Seasons
hero.story1: For anyone who has lingered in Hanoi, memories of the flower seasons are among the most profound.
hero.story2: The wistful emotion of pausing by flower-laden bicycles drifting through the alleys… every change of season stirs the soul in its own surprising way.
hero.story3: And it was with that very emotion, while humming along to the song "Hanoi's 12 Flower Seasons", that something natural awakened within me.
hero.founderAvatarAlt: Portrait of CEO Le Thi Hoa Dao
hero.closing: From the desire to bring those peaceful emotions, Hoa Theo Mua has distilled its own brand values — the good things meant to be entrusted in every product.

values.title: Values We Pursue
values.description: From that wish to bring peaceful emotions, Hoa Theo Mua has shaped five core values — good things sent forth in every product placed in our customers' hands.

enjoy.title: Enjoy Life
enjoy.description: Hoa Theo Mua doesn't only deliver flowers; we send forth positive values so you can feel the beauty and listen to the peace within. Enjoying every bloom is your way of cherishing life and finding your own joy.

eco.title: Eco-friendly
eco.description: We use natural materials such as rattan baskets, bamboo holders, and kraft paper to reduce plastic and create products that are beautiful and kind to the environment.

elegant.title: Refined
elegant.description: Hoa Theo Mua understands and celebrates the beauty of flowers for a woman's soul. We tend to every detail, bringing a sense of resonance and love.

simple.title: Simple
simple.description: Inspired by natural beauty — rustic materials and gentle hues that honor the genuine charm of flowers.

vietnamese.title: Honoring Vietnamese Values
vietnamese.description: We cherish and honor Vietnamese beauty: from flower seasons, craft villages, to creative products that bear the mark of Vietnamese culture.

productLines.title: Main Product Lines
productLines.description: Fresh bouquets designed with care in a natural style — capturing the beauty and vitality of each season, made to gift the people you cherish on every special occasion.

myDuyen.name: Ms. My Duyen
myDuyen.quote: I'm very satisfied with Hoa Theo Mua's service. The designs are diverse and fit many occasions. The consultants are warm and ready to help me choose the perfect bouquet. The flowers are beautiful and refined — I'll keep supporting Hoa Theo Mua many more times!

vanViet.name: Mr. Van Viet
vanViet.quote: A friend once bought my graduation bouquet at Hoa Theo Mua and I truly loved it! Fresh flowers, lovely designs — they made my graduation even more meaningful. Thank you for the quality and the emotion.

thanhMai.name: Ms. Thanh Mai
thanhMai.quote: Hoa Theo Mua is our company's choice for partner gifts and important events. The flowers are always fresh, the designs refined, and the team is exceptionally professional in consultation and on-time delivery.

cut.title: Trim stems fresh
cut.description: Cut stems diagonally every 1–2 days to help flowers absorb water and stay fresh longer.

water.title: Clean water daily
water.description: Refresh water and rinse the vase daily; remove leaves submerged in water to prevent bacteria.

shade.title: Avoid direct sunlight
shade.description: Place the bouquet in a cool spot, away from harsh sun, strong wind, and ripening fruit.

temperature.title: Comfortable room temperature
temperature.description: Ideal at 18–22°C — a lightly air-conditioned room helps the flowers keep their shape.
